support.intro: Open the customer's environment in the web app to see what they see. You cannot change anything.
support.bullet_readonly: Read-only session: every change is refused by the server.
support.bullet_expiry: The session expires after 30 minutes and does not renew.
support.bullet_documents: Employee documents and export downloads stay out of reach.
support.reason_ph: E.g. checking a report about missing stamps

disable.label: Disable {{module}}

api.desc: API keys so a management system, a turnstile or a BI tool can reach the company data. Can also be enabled later via the modules icon.

profile.title: Billing details
profile.empty: The company has not entered its billing details yet.

vatReview.hint: Mark the VAT number as checked by hand. It is for numbers not listed on VIES or not verifiable: they stay under "VAT to review" until you review them.

signup.title: Signup
signup.none: No website signup: the company was created from the console.
signup.name: Name

overrides.title: Limit overrides
overrides.hint: Courtesy extras on top of what is paid: the higher of plan and override wins, and a ticked module stays on even without a subscription. Leave blank for no override.
overrides.managedHint: Overrides do not apply under manual billing: change the limits with the pencil icon and the modules with the modules icon.
overrides.invalid: Overrides must be whole numbers from 1 up.
overrides.clearConfirm: Remove every override? The company goes back to the limits and modules it pays for.

mode.title: Billing mode
mode.stripeDesc: Stripe: limits and modules derive from the paid subscriptions (plus overrides) and update on their own.
mode.managedDesc: Manual billing: limits and modules are edited by hand, as for partner companies. Stripe no longer touches the company.
mode.toManagedText: From now on limits and modules are edited by hand (pencil and modules icons) and keep their current values until you change them. Use it for a custom deal or to hand the company to a partner.
mode.toStripeText: Limits and modules will be recomputed from the Stripe subscriptions (plus overrides) and the values set by hand will be replaced. With no active subscription the company falls back to the free plan's limits.
mode.liveSubs_one: The company has 1 active Stripe subscription. What should happen to it?
mode.liveSubs_other: The company has {{count}} active Stripe subscriptions. What should happen to them?

subs.keep_hint: Stripe keeps charging: only choose this if the customer keeps paying that way.
subs.cancel_at_period_end_hint: They stay active until the end of the period already paid, then close with no further charges.
subs.cancel_now_hint: They close now, with no refund for the current period. This cannot be undone.

mode.cancelDisabled: Stripe billing is disabled on this server: subscriptions cannot be cancelled from here.

sync.title: Stripe sync
sync.hint: Re-reads subscriptions and their state from Stripe and recomputes limits and modules. Use it when an update from Stripe did not arrive.

payments.rule: Immediate invoice within 12 days of the payment, or one deferred invoice per company by the 15th of the following month (DPR 633/72, art. 21 c.4). Check with your accountant.

group.hint: One deferred invoice can cover all of this company's payments for the month: issue it, then mark them all with the same number.

detail.title: Payment
detail.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the text by hand.

mark.label: Mark as invoiced

mark.intro: Issue the e-invoice from your invoicing software first, then enter its number and date here.
mark.introMany: Same number and date on all of them: they are the lines of a single deferred invoice.
mark.partial: {{failed}} of {{count}} payments were not updated: try again.

unmark.label: Undo invoicing
unmark.confirm: Undo invoice no. {{number}}? The payment goes back to "to invoice". An invoice already issued must be reversed with a credit note in your invoicing software.
unmark.done: Invoicing undone: the payment is to invoice again.
